item.title: Experts say New Jersey has been falling behind on battery energy storage system fire safety
item.description: New Jersey's statewide fire code was last updated back in 2018, long before battery energy storage became well-known.

item.title: Jury convicts man in killings of 4 people sleeping on NYC streets, rejecting insanity defense
item.description: A man who fatally beat four men as they slept on New York City's streets has been convicted of murder. A jury on Thursday rejected Randy Santos' insanity defense in the 2019 rampage.
